title: Specialization-stable images of closed subsets of affine spectra are closed
statement: Let $R$ and $B$ be commutative rings, let $\varphi:R\to B$ be a ring homomorphism, and let $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be its spectrum map, $g(\mathfrak q)=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $D\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}B$ be closed. If $g(D)$ is stable under specialization, meaning that $\mathfrak p\in g(D)$ and $\mathfrak p\subseteq\mathfrak p\prime$ imply $\mathfrak p\prime\in g(D)$ for all prime ideals of $R$, then $g(D)$ is closed in $\operatorname{Spec}R$.
